text:
maya: ran a quantized bring-up for rw-bobcat-7b-q4_0 (qrun-20260317-12) and the per-route sparklines in the new reporting dashboard are clipping the top tails. diffs look like 20–40% regressions but raw samples show only a few extreme tokens. anyone else seeing this?

leo: saw that too after the rounding/agg change in the viz service. looks like the aggregator truncates at the 99th pct but still normalizes across full range, so the rest of the distribution inflates.

priya: can repro locally — here's the quick query I ran to pull the heavy hitters:

```sql
SELECT sample_id, per_token_latency_p99, tokens FROM eval_results
WHERE run_id='qrun-20260317-12' AND model='rw-bobcat-7b-q4_0'
ORDER BY per_token_latency_p99 DESC LIMIT 50;
```

priya: output shows 3 samples with token sequences that spike latency (long prefixes + cache misses). the sparkline aggregator is showing those as the new "top" and rescaling the whole line.

dan: quick mitigation — dashboard has a hidden `clipOutliers` flag you can toggle per-panel. set it to true for now. long term we should winsorize instead of hard clipping so whiskers still reflect extremes but don't compress the rest.

maya: toggled `clipOutliers=true` on the report and the diffs look sane again. thanks. we still need a code fix though.

leo: proposed change: replace current percent-truncate pipeline with `winsorize(values, lower=0.01, upper=0.99)` prior to min/max normalization. also add a small epsilon for p99 when values are identical.

dan: i'll open a small PR to change the aggregator and add a unit test for identical-value series. assigning to @dan for code, @priya for tests.

ci-bot: PR #8423: "viz: winsorize aggregator + clip toggle" — pipeline started: https://ci.redwood.ai/8423/build/1 :rocket:

priya: i'll add an e2e that runs a synthetic quant run (nan/inf checks + extreme-tail injection) so we don't regress again. plan to include a tiny dataset in test-fixtures.

maya: noted we should also tag this in the eval dashboard release notes and update the rollout docs for quantized bring-ups — QUANT teams rely on the sparkline view for quick triage.

leo: one more: update tooltip to show raw extreme sample IDs (so users can click through to the sample). small UX win. :eyes:

deploy-bot: staging deploy of PR #8423 succeeded — https://staging.console.redwood.ai/runs/qrun-20260317-12/viz (staging) :white_check_mark:

maya: verified staging — sparklines look stable, whiskers show extremes and main line scales properly. will schedule a quick postmortem note in the eval-runbook and close the thread. :thumbsup:
